plugins.name: co-scientist
plugins.description: A team of AI agents that generates, peer-reviews, debates and evolves ideas for a hard, open-ended problem, then ranks them in an Elo tournament and hands you a research overview. Works for science, engineering, product and strategy goals.

plugins.name: co-scientist-lab
plugins.description: Co-Scientist with an Experiment agent: it tests each idea by running your project's own training, benchmark or test command, ranks ideas on measured results instead of argument, and loops until your target metric is reached or the round budget is spent.
